name: Ines Calloway
title: Professor of Biology and Dean of Natural Sciences
research: River ecology, freshwater mussels, field methods
bio:
Ines Calloway teaches in the Biology program at Larkmoor College. Their teaching and research focus on river ecology, freshwater mussels, field methods.

Students work with Professor Calloway on research projects, independent studies and senior theses. They have advised more than forty undergraduate projects, several of which became conference presentations.
